sources.title: GitHub - nxr-dine/quran-whisper: Fine-tuning OpenAI Whisper for Arabic ...
sources.snippet: This project provides a beginner-friendly structure to fine-tune OpenAI's Whisper model (specifically whisper-small) on the Tarteel Quran recitation dataset. This fine-tuned model can accurately convert Arabic Quran audio into text, which you can later plug into your Flutter application via an API.
